title: Hydratation problem with react-instantsearch-nextjs and 2 InstantSearchNext components in the same page
body: ### 🐛 Current behavior Maybe I'm doing it wrong, but I need to have multiple instance of instant search in a page, with different configuration, using the same index. To reproduce, I took the next js app and changing it to only display 2 boxes, one displaying 4 Apple products, and one displaying 4 Hp products. as you can see there is an error, it's an hydration error. looking at the generated html, I can see 2 different objects attached to the same window property, I suspect it's the problem. ### 🔍 Steps to reproduce 1. Use the sandbox preview url https://lysjwf-3000.csb.app/ 2. observe the flickering on the top set of results 3. look at nextjs issue at the bottom left repo here https://github.com/stuff/instantsearch-nextjs-app-bug ### Live reproduction https://lysjwf-3000.csb.app/ ### 💭 Expected behavior No flickering, no hydration error ### Package version algoliasearch: 5.1.1, react-instantsearch: 7.22.1, react-instantsearch-nextjs: 1.0.11 ### Operating system *No response* ### Browser *No response* ### Code of Conduct * \[x] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct
